name: One-sun braised mackerel
summary: Cá thu kho một nắng is a prepared line on the 20 June 2013 board at Thành Long, vịnh Bến Bèo, and at Viễn Dương, số 12 đường Núi Ngọc. The name says braised one-sun mackerel. Cá thu without “kho” is a separate line, at the floating doors Phương Hùng, vịnh Bến Bèo, and Xuân Hồng, vịnh Cái Bèo. The plate is not on the Thái Dương line.
howToEat: Order it as that named plate. No further method is given. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Núi Ngọc and vịnh Bến Bèo on the 2013 board. A current door is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cá thu kho một nắng on Cat Ba
seoDescription: Cá thu kho một nắng is on the 20 June 2013 board at vịnh Bến Bèo and at 12 Núi Ngọc. A current door and price are Check on arrival.
